events.observed_signal: The immutable YouTube V001 manifest pins the complete V1 registry fingerprint, so changing that snapshot to register another source would invalidate historical replay.

correction.action: Preserved V1 byte-identically and added a closed registry catalog, immutable V2 snapshot, exact pinned resolver and V002 manifest with explicit supersession lineage.

events.schema_impact: Adds independent V2 registry, catalog and immutable-manifest schemas without modifying either V1 schema.
events.quality_impact: Prevents false historical integrity drift while preserving the existing technical quality gate and Analysis ownership.

learning.reusable_lesson: An executed manifest must pin an immutable registry snapshot; additive registration belongs in a new snapshot and a superseding manifest identity.
learning.future_prevention: Require cataloged snapshot identity, path and fingerprint plus historical byte-invariant replay for every registry evolution.

events.observed_signal: The first targeted additive-composition run failed because the test adapter omitted parser_id and mapper_id required by Connector Kit's exact identity contract.

correction.action: Added the declared parser and mapper identities to the test-only synthetic adapter while leaving the runtime contract and source connectors unchanged.

events.schema_impact: None; this correction aligns the deterministic fixture with the existing Connector Kit identity contract.
events.quality_impact: Ensures the additive proof exercises exact adapter/parser/mapper composition rather than bypassing identity validation.

learning.reusable_lesson: Synthetic implementations must satisfy the same declared component identities as production-facing registry composition.
learning.future_prevention: Construct additive fixtures with complete adapter, parser, mapper and connector-contract identity before first execution.

events.observed_signal: Contract self-review found that a syntactically valid catalog could form a registry supersession cycle or disagree with the supersession declared by the loaded V2 snapshot.

correction.action: Added registry-catalog cycle detection and required the loaded V2 snapshot supersession identity to equal the catalog entry before execution.

events.schema_impact: No shape change; runtime validation now enforces the lineage already represented by the V2 schema and catalog.
events.quality_impact: Prevents a catalog and loaded snapshot from presenting inconsistent migration provenance while otherwise producing valid records.

learning.reusable_lesson: A version catalog must validate both graph integrity and agreement with the immutable artifact it indexes.
learning.future_prevention: Include catalog-cycle and indexed-artifact-lineage mismatch negatives in every versioned registry suite.
